name: Junior Robotics Bootcamp
description: A two-week intensive where learners build, wire and program their first autonomous robot using the Quarky platform. Runs during the April school holiday.

name: AI & Coding Accelerator
description: Teens explore machine-learning concepts, build a computer-vision project and present it on demo day. Held over the August holiday.

name: Creative Electronics Camp
description: Learners design wearable and interactive art pieces with sensors, LEDs and micro-controllers. Completed cohort — next run to be announced.
